name: agent-regression-suite
description: Dependency-light Node CLI that replays frozen agent scenarios, fingerprints traces, and uses SPRT to declare Pass/Fail/Inconclusive regression verdicts with CI-gated reports.

scripts.demo:pass: node bin/agent-regression-suite.js --fixtures fixtures/scenarios.json --agent fixtures/mock-agent-baseline.json --baseline fixtures/mock-agent-baseline.json --runs 10 --out reports/demo-pass
scripts.demo:fail: node bin/agent-regression-suite.js --fixtures fixtures/scenarios.json --agent fixtures/mock-agent-regressed.json --baseline fixtures/mock-agent-baseline.json --runs 10 --out reports/demo-fail
